ST-20.title: CI cache tuning to reduce Playwright suite runtime

sign_off_record.notes: Approved. Cache key correctly derived from package-lock.json (1.58.2), invalidates cleanly on version bump. Conditional install logic verified correct (no missing-browser path). 'playwright install-deps chromium' confirmed as a real CLI command. Applied to all 3 jobs that install Playwright browsers. Post-approval, real before/after CI measurement obtained: cache-miss vs cache-hit rerun of the same job (shard 1/4) showed the browser-install step dropping 19s->12s (37% faster for that step), but total job duration effectively unchanged (~220s vs ~219s) since npm ci and the test run itself dominate on GitHub-hosted runners that already install Chromium quickly. Documented honestly in the workflow comment rather than overstating the win. No test reliability regression: all 4 shards passed on both the cache-miss and cache-hit runs.

Initial review BLOCKED: creating a new scripts/git-hooks/ core.hooksPath would have silently overwritten the pre-existing .githooks/ setup (router-registration check with no CI equivalent + gitleaks scan). Fixed by consolidating both hooks into .githooks/. Re-verified: prepare script correct, pre-commit hook logic byte-identical, test suite 6/6 passing from new location, router-registration script still exits 0, no stale duplicate directory. Cleared.
